items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Because Guy Lombardo used to put a show out there every year for the whole summer

ctx.x: to Columbus we’re leaving tomorrow night after the gig.” He says, “You’re leaving after the gig? You’re going to drive” We says, “Yeah.” He says, “Let me give you a little clue. Don’t drive more than 200 miles, I don’t care how cold it is, without getting out the car and running around the car ten times.” We said, “What?” “Trust me.” I think he saved our lives. Because we did it, we listened to him. Because we had two cars, we were caravan style. And we went a couple of hundred miles, we stopped, got out of the…

see? So now in ’66, Glaser calls me again because — what happened? Oh he said, “we’re going into Jones Beach.” That’s what made me go back with the band. They were going to Jones Beach in New York for the summer. Because Guy Lombardo used to put a show out there every year for the whole summer, So that convinced me to say okay. And I did, I went back in ’66. And it’s too long a story. But what else have you got to do?
Well we’re going to have to do Part Two sometime.
